text:
anya: Heads up — admission controller started hitting hysteresis oscillations on EUW yesterday during 11:30-13:00 UTC load spike. p99 climbed while p95 stayed OK. Need quick triage.
sam: Saw that, looks like batch sizes collapsed under burst -> more small jobs, our batching threshold decreased, increasing per-token overhead. Queue depth spiked.
jorge: Can we simulate with the seasonal forecast? Q2 promo will increase short chat sessions by ~40% per our model.
mira: I pushed a short patch that bumps min-batch from 4 -> 8 for dedicated pools. Observed reduction in per-request latency but risk of added admit delay.
kai: Numbers? rough p99 before/after?
mira: Before: p99=820ms, p95=180ms. After (staging small patch): p99=540ms, p95=200ms. Queueing delay reduced but tail still heavy for cold-start GPUs.
ops-bot: Alert: EUW1 cluster GPU utilization 92% at 11:46 UTC, preemptible pods scaling limited.
anya: We need capacity math: if Q2 promo adds 40% short sessions, and batching improves token throughput by 1.7x at avg seq len 64, how many extra GPU-hours and headroom to keep p99 under 700ms? Using rough numbers.
sam: Quick calc: current steady throughput per GPU for short sessions = 1200 reqs/hr. With 40% increase -> 1680 reqs/hr. With batching 1.7x -> effective 2856 reqs/hr per GPU. So at steady state we might not need extra GPUs, but admission latency for bursts still an issue.
jorge: Bursts are spiky; admission control needs hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping. Suggest soft-cap window: if admit rate > 1.2*target for >30s, block new admits for 60s, then ramp at 10% every 30s.
kai: We should model queueing — do we use M/M/1 or our event-driven sim? Link: https://redwood.internal/sim/harness?run=admit-2026-03
mira: I ran the sim with the soft-cap params above: p99 median across 100 runs drops to 650ms. Without hysteresis, p99 oscillates between 500-1200ms.
anya: Cost tradeoffs: if we provision +2 GPUs in euw1 (A100-ish at $3.5/hr), monthly hours ~720 -> cost +$5040. Cheaper than SLA penalties? unclear.
sam: Alternative: reserve 1 extra GPU and enable burst autoscale to usw2 with cross-region fallback. Cross-region adds ~120ms to p99 but keeps capacity.
jorge: Proposal: deploy hysteresis policy to prod admission controller today, monitor 1% sample routing to new policy. If p99 < 700ms for 2 hours during controlled smoke test, scale +1 GPU pre-weekend.
anya: :thumbsup: I'll file an infra runbook and create a small on-call playbook. Anyone object to rollout plan?
kai: No objections. I'll prepare sim results and a short dashboard panel.
ops-bot: Deploy started: admission-controller v2.14 -> prod-euw1 at 13:10 UTC
mira: Monitor note: keep eye on GPU spin-up times; if warmup > 45s we'll adjust the hysteresis windows.
sam: Got it, will watch traces and run a synthetic traffic profile.
anya: Also adding a brief note to capacity spreadsheet (Q2 forecast) with both provision and cross-region fallback scenarios.
jorge: :eyes: thanks everyone, let's sync after the 2-hour smoke window.
